title: Simulation of a zero test
statement: Let $m$ be the number of registers, let $\Lambda$ be a set of program states, and let $A$ assign an instruction to each state. Fix an initial state $l_*$, an oracle on Boolean words, an input word $x$, register values $v\colon\{0,\ldots,m-1\}\to\mathbb{N}$, an output word, and an integer $W\ge 0$. Suppose the instruction at $l$ tests whether register $r$ is zero, with successor states $l_1$ and $l_0'$. Then the compiled program, starting in state $l$ with those register values and output, reaches the configuration with state $l_1$ if $v(r)=0$ and state $l_0'$ otherwise; throughout the run before that configuration, no call state is visited and every register head position lies between $-1$ and $W$, inclusive.
